verdict.rationale: skills.sh covers all three distribution routes in the story. Project-scope installs are the default and are documented as "Committed with your project, shared with team." Skills install from shared GitHub, GitLab or Azure repos, private ones included, using existing auth. Discovery runs through the skills.sh leaderboard and org-wide search, and non-interactive CI installs plus restore from skills-lock.json support standardization. Missing for 10: the lockfile restore is labeled experimental, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of team-wide rollout.
